definitions.explanation: Literature that prioritizes artistic expression and exploration of the human condition over commercial appeal or entertainment. Contrasted with popular fiction (大衆文学). A central category in Japanese literary criticism and publishing.

notes:
USAGE:
The distinction between {純文学|じゅんぶんがく} and ⟦{大衆|たいしゅう}{文学|ぶんがく}→大衆文学：16512_taishuubungaku⟧ (popular fiction) is deeply embedded in Japanese literary culture. The two most prestigious literary prizes in Japan reflect this divide: the ⟦{芥川賞|あくたがわしょう}→芥川賞：15559_akutagawashou⟧ (Akutagawa Prize) for {純文学|じゅんぶんがく} and the ⟦{直木賞|なおきしょう}→直木賞：15560_naokishou⟧ (Naoki Prize) for popular fiction.
